newsitem.title: USA: Bigmar seeks FDA approval of drug.
newsitem.headline: Bigmar seeks FDA approval of drug.

text.p: Drug maker Bigmar Inc said Tuesday it had submitted its first Abbreviated New Drug Application to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for its generic version of Leucovorin Calcium for injection.
Bigmar said in a statement it had already begun shipping Leucovorin Calcium for injection to Germany to meet orders worth more than $1.0 million.
Switzerland has approved the manufacture of the drug at the company's pharmaceutical plant in Barbengo, Switzerland, it said.

"While additional (submissions to the Food and Drug Administration) are planned in the upcoming months, we expect the first submission to trigger an FDA sponsored pre-approval inspection at our Swiss manufacturing facility," it said.
Leucovorin Calcium is used along with the administration of chemotherapeutic agents.
Bigmar said it estimated the global market for the product to be more than $156 million.
